value.rationale: The exact inball of a natural combinatorial polytope under intrinsic diagonal Euclidean metrics is controlled by weighted discrepancy and encodes weak NP-completeness even on stars. It explains why an easily computed parity radius in an isotropic case becomes a genuine discrete partition optimization under metric perturbation; tangency patterns and unweighted incenter dimensions are supplied as structural consequences.
